searchText: I will write a detailed guide to how to run this. But you would need an archive node synced with Erigon 2 (v2.60.x). Do you want to do this exercise or do you just need the files? I just need the files but it will be nice to have a way to generate new file up to date regularly with the last blocks. How long it take to have an archive node ?
